query:
SELECT 
  m.timeSlot,
  CASE m.timeSlot
    WHEN 1 THEN '10:15–10:45'
    WHEN 2 THEN '10:45–11:15'
    WHEN 3 THEN '13:30–14:00'
    WHEN 4 THEN '14:00–14:30'
    WHEN 5 THEN '14:45–15:15'
    WHEN 6 THEN '15:15–15:45'
    WHEN 7 THEN '10:30–11:00'
    WHEN 8 THEN '11:00–11:30'
    WHEN 9 THEN '13:15–13:45'
    WHEN 10 THEN '13:45–14:15'
    WHEN 11 THEN '14:30–15:00'
    WHEN 12 THEN '15:00–15:30'
  END as time,
  m.attendeeId,
  m.id as meetingId
FROM meetings m
JOIN sponsors s ON s.id = m.sponsorId
WHERE s.companyName = 'Wilson'
ORDER BY m.timeSlot;
